summary: The numbered single-site plan is done. A dropped-in plugin can boot, print assets, save a settings page, store a custom post type, edit that type in the block editor, read and write its post meta, register a taxonomy, run its activation hook once, see the signed-in role, and be deactivated without stopping the others.

done.title: WordPress 7.1.4 single-site behavior in the numbered plan
done.note: Schema, core blocks, theme, comments, archives, SEO, fields, forms, security, and the shop slice. See compatibility-plan.md.

done.title: One PHP CLI worker for drop-in plugins
done.note: Hooks, shortcodes, and wp_head and wp_footer echo. ADR-002.

done.title: Store a plugin basename that contains a slash
wp_remote_get and wp_remote_post for public HTTP
Draw plugin settings pages and save registered options
done.note: siteurl, active_plugins, role options, salts, and rustpress_* keys stay refused.

done.title: Register a post type and store its rows
done.note: Admin list at /wp-admin/edit.php?post_type={name}. Public permalink is /{slug}/. Revisions and template types are refused.

done.title: Edit a plugin post type in the block editor
done.note: A show_ui type opens the block editor. REST reads and writes that type at /wp-json/wp/v2/{name}. An update cannot switch the row to another type. Revisions, templates, products, and orders stay on their own routes.

done.title: get_post_meta and update_post_meta for a dropped-in plugin
done.note: add_post_meta and delete_post_meta are included. Values are text. An array is refused. A missing post or a refused type is not written.

done.title: register_taxonomy with a list screen
done.note: A show_ui taxonomy is listed at /wp-admin/edit-tags.php?taxonomy={name}. category, post_tag, nav_menu, link_category, and post_format stay reserved.

done.title: Run activation callbacks when an administrator activates a plugin
done.note: Boot includes active plugins and does not run the hook again.

done.title: is_admin and current_user_can follow the signed-in visitor
done.note: A visitor is false. manage_options stays true while a plugin settings page is drawn.

done.title: Deactivate one plugin without restarting the worker
done.note: That plugin's hooks and shortcodes stop. The others keep running. Turning it back on reuses the loaded copy.

out_of_plan.title: Multisite tables and wp_users.spam and wp_users.deleted
Vendoring wp-admin or wp-includes, or stubbing wp-admin/includes/file.php
WooCommerce lookup tables, variations, coupons, shipping rates, tax, and payment gateways
